title: Family calendar component diagram
description: The calendar Worker, the login service it signs people in through, and its database.

components.name: Calendar Worker (index.js)
components.responsibility: Routes /calendar: the library's auth routes, invites, the JSON API and the static client.

components.name: icelander-auth (vendor)
components.responsibility: The app side of the one sign-in: state cookie, token check, redeem and live session lookup through the ACCOUNTS binding.

components.name: Households (households.js)
components.responsibility: Household creation on first visit, members, single-use invite links, leaving and removal.

components.name: Schedules (schedules.js)
components.responsibility: People, schedules, weekly rules, exceptions and the agenda, with household scoping and edit rights.

components.name: Expansion (expand.js)
components.responsibility: Weekly rules, alternating weeks, validity and exceptions into dated occurrences; pure.

components.name: Client
components.responsibility: Week view with person filter, schedule editor, household screen; Icelandic and English, light only.

components.name: icelander.net login service
components.responsibility: Google and the other providers; users, sessions and the service-binding entrypoint.

components.name: D1 database
components.responsibility: households, members, invites, people, schedules, schedule_rules, schedule_exceptions.

relationships.description: Every request resolves the user's households first.
Redeems tokens and looks sessions up through the ACCOUNTS service binding.
All schedule rows, always with household_id.
